lines.2: 「Sato's lunches are as delicious as ever!」
lines.3: Though this one was a little salty.
lines.9: 「I never planned to learn how to cook. If I have time to learn that, I'll absorb useful knowledge instead.」
lines.10: Now that sounded like the top student in the country.
lines.12: 「Of course. There is no glory without effort.」
lines.13: That was not very convincing while she was showing us a rose.
lines.14: And her 'effort' was probably the slightest little thing.
lines.15: It must be nice to be a natural genius.
lines.16: 「It sounds lively over here. Oh, you have fried chicken in your lunch. That's my favorite.」
lines.17: 「It's rare to see you in the cafeteria, Otome.」
lines.18: 「The weather is perfectly clear today, and the breeze feels good. I wanted to eat while enjoying the view.」
lines.19: 「You may use the seats behind us, Otome.」
lines.20: 「I'm here with friends. We waited in line and found seats normally.」
lines.21: 「How conscientious. Just what I'd expect from the head of the discipline committee.」
lines.22: 「Tetchan! Hurry up and come over here!」
lines.26: 「Heh... Ahaha! Her name's Tetsu, so they call her Tetchan!」
lines.27: 「Ahahahaha! Maybe I should try calling her that sometime.」
lines.30: 「What's wrong? Say it. You wanted to call me that, didn't you?」
